findings.summary: AddWithTTL and Get silently swallow Redis errors with no logging; combined with this diff removing the eager EnableActions call, a transient Redis write failure at AddWithTTL now produces a silently, permanently stuck client (handleStatusEventFailed's not-found path never unlocks).
